We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Please note: We are actively hiring for this position. However, due to the current regional situation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, our hiring process may take longer than usual. We appreciate your patience and will keep you informed throughout the process.

Test Engineer – Servers (ISG)

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (Special Integrated Logistics Zone)

Department: Engineering

Experience: 2+ years preferred

Employment type: Full-time

About The Role

Before a server leaves our line, it has to prove it works. As a Test Engineer in Lenovo’s Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) in Riyadh, you’ll build and run the production testing that makes sure it does.

You’ll prepare, validate and improve the test processes, stations and configurations behind our server manufacturing at every stage: new product introduction (NPI), line qualification, pilot runs, ramp-up and mass production. When a unit fails, you’ll dig into the data and logs, find out why, and fix it, so testing stays stable and production keeps moving.

What You’ll Do

Set up, validate and maintain production test stations, test environments and equipment
Deploy test software and manage test code and configurations, including BIOS, BMC and firmware versions
Analyze test failures using test data, logs and on-site observation, and resolve issues through to closure
Support server configuration testing, including OS, RAID and network setup
Make sure test data uploads correctly to the MES for full traceability
Drive improvements in test stability, yield and efficiency
Work with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, suppliers and global Lenovo teams, and give hands-on support when urgent issues come up

What You’ll Bring

A bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical, Electronic or Computer Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, IT or a related field
2+ years in server, PC or electronics manufacturing, test engineering or system validation (preferred)
A good understanding of production test processes, station setup, test equipment, logs and failure analysis
Familiarity with server hardware, BIOS/BMC/firmware, Windows Server and Linux, RAID and network troubleshooting
Good written and spoken English
Willingness to give hands-on support on the production floor during ramp-up

What We Offer

An international team with a high focus on Gender Diversity.
Employee Assistance Program, e.g., for psychological, legal financial consultancy
You are joining a company that prioritizes sustainable solutions like CO2 Offset, Asset Recovery Services, and the Lenovo Certified Refurbished portfolio.
Access to training for personal development - Internal E-learning Development Platform Available for Employees
Mentorship program



We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on IT Infrastructure Engineer to keep our technology environment secure, stable and highly available. This position is open to Saudi nationals only.

Key Responsibilities
Infrastructure & Systems
Manage and maintain Windows/Linux servers and virtual environments (VMware / Hyper-V)
Administer Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and other core infrastructure services
Support Microsoft 365 and Azure hybrid environments
Network & Security
Manage LAN/WAN, switches, routers and VLAN segmentation
Administer firewalls (FortiGate), access controls and infrastructure hardening
Coordinate with Information Security to remediate vulnerabilities and close regulatory observations
Resilience & Compliance
Oversee backup systems and disaster recovery (DR) plans
Implement patch management in line with SAMA and internal compliance requirements
Support technology audits and IT governance controls
Operations

Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues
Coordinate with vendors and service providers
Maintain documentation, standards and operational best practices

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field
3–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure
Hands-on experience with Windows Server & Active Directory, VMware or Hyper-V, FortiGate, Microsoft 365 & Azure, and LAN/WAN/VLANs
Solid understanding of backup, disaster recovery and business continuity
Familiarity with regulatory compliance and IT governance frameworks; experience in a SAMA-regulated environment is an advantage
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and teamwork skills

Preferred Certifications
CCNA
Microsoft certifications
VMware Certified Professional (VCP)
ITIL Foundation
Fortinet certifications

How to Apply
Please send your CV to careers@byc.sa with IT Infrastructure Engineer in the email subject line.

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer – Manual Testing & Application Monitoring to ensure the functional quality, technical stability, and reliability of our digital eCommerce platforms.
This role combines hands-on manual testing, API and integration testing, application observability, and production incident investigation. The successful candidate will validate complex transactional customer journeys, troubleshoot technical defects, monitor application health, and work closely with engineering teams and external development vendors to resolve customer-impacting issues.
The ideal candidate goes beyond executing predefined test cases. They can independently investigate application errors, interpret technical evidence, identify root causes or contributing factors, and communicate findings clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
Experience with Sentry is an advantage. Candidates with strong hands-on experience using equivalent application performance monitoring (APM) or observability platforms are equally encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities
1. Functional and Manual Testing
Design, develop, and execute functional, regression, integration, smoke, and end-to-end test cases.
Validate complex web-based customer journeys, including registration, quotation, checkout, payment, and post-purchase transactions.
Perform cross-browser compatibility, responsive design, and mobile web testing.
Review business requirements, UX designs, and acceptance criteria to identify gaps and ensure adequate test coverage.
Document, prioritize, and track defects, supporting user acceptance testing (UAT), release validation, and production readiness.
2. Application Monitoring and Production Observability
Operate application monitoring and observability tools to investigate production issues across frontend, backend, API, and infrastructure layers.
Monitor application exceptions, failed transactions, API availability, latency, slow page loads, user-impacting errors, and performance regressions.
Investigate incidents by correlating exception stack traces, application logs, browser console and network evidence, distributed traces, session replays, release changes, and service health indicators.
Analyze incident severity, recurrence, frequency, and impact on customer journeys and business operations.
Maintain and improve monitoring dashboards, alert configurations, thresholds, incident classifications, and escalation procedures.
Validate monitoring coverage, monitor release health, and confirm that production fixes resolve the reported issues.
3. API and Integration Testing
Test REST APIs using Postman or equivalent tools, validating request and response payloads, authentication, status codes, and error handling.
Investigate HTTP errors, timeouts, unexpected responses, and integration failures.
Validate integrations between eCommerce platforms, payment gateways, core systems, and third-party services.
Use browser developer tools and relevant diagnostic evidence to investigate client-server communication issues.
4. Technical Troubleshooting and Incident Management
Act as a technical quality contact between business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and external development vendors.
Reproduce production incidents and provide clear, evidence-based defect reports with steps to reproduce, logs, screenshots, network traces, and other relevant technical details.
Investigate recurring defects, identify likely root causes or contributing factors, and verify corrective actions.
Prioritize incidents according to customer impact, business criticality, and technical severity.
Support effective incident escalation and resolution in collaboration with engineering and application support teams.
5. Reporting and Continuous Improvement
Maintain QA execution reports, defect registers, incident investigation reports, and application stability reports.
Track test coverage, critical production defects, failed transactions, incident recurrence, detection and resolution times, and release quality.
Recommend improvements to test processes, observability coverage, alerting, incident handling, and release validation.
Produce clear technical findings and concise summaries for business and engineering stakeholders.

Requirements
Mandatory Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
At least 6+ years of software QA experience, with strong hands-on manual testing of web applications
Proven experience testing complex transactional web applications, ideally involving eCommerce, checkout, payments, or similar customer-facing workflows.
Practical API testing experience using Postman, Swagger, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of HTTP, JSON, REST APIs, status codes, and client-server architecture.
Proficiency in browser developer tools, particularly Console and Network, for investigating JavaScript errors, failed requests, and API issues.
Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent defect and test management tools.
Ability to investigate technical defects, document reproducible evidence, and collaborate effectively with developers and external vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings and business impact clearly.

Highly Preferred
Hands-on production experience with at least one application observability or APM platform, such as Sentry, Datadog APM/RUM, New Relic, Dynatrace, Elastic Observability, Grafana, Cisco AppDynamics, Azure Application Insights, or AWS CloudWatch.
Demonstrated personal involvement in investigating production incidents affecting application functionality, performance, API availability, or customer transactions.
Experience interpreting application logs, metrics, traces, exception stack traces, API latency, and release health indicators.
Experience in eCommerce, fintech, banking, insurance, or other transaction-intensive digital environments.

Additional Advantages
Direct experience configuring Sentry alerts, dashboards, issue tracking, or instrumentation.
Basic JavaScript or TypeScript and SQL knowledge.
Familiarity with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, Agile delivery, GA4, or behavioral analytics tools.
ISTQB certification.

Expected Deliverables
Functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test cases with execution reports.
A well-maintained defect register containing reproducible steps and technical evidence.
Application monitoring dashboards, alert configurations, and application stability reports.
Production incident investigation reports and API/integration testing results.
Release readiness assessments, post-deployment validation, and quality improvement recommendations.

Important: This is a technical QA role, not a position limited to executing predefined manual test cases. Candidates must be comfortable troubleshooting technical issues and are strongly preferred to have hands-on production monitoring and incident investigation experience.

About The Role

Every phone that comes off our line has to be flashed, tested and proven ready for the customer. As a Test Engineer in Lenovo’s Mobile Business Group (MBG) in Riyadh, you’ll make sure that happens reliably, at speed and at scale.

You’ll prepare, validate and improve the production test processes, stations and configurations behind our phone manufacturing at every stage: new product introduction (NPI), line qualification, pilot runs, ramp-up and mass production. When a test fails or a station misbehaves, you’ll find the cause quickly and fix it. That protects product quality and keeps the line ready to run.

What You’ll Do

Set up, validate and maintain production test stations, test equipment and fixtures
Deploy test software and manage test code and configurations under change control
Support software flashing, functional testing, RF testing and other phone test stages on the line
Analyze test failures, logs and station abnormalities, and resolve software, equipment and connectivity issues
Make sure test data uploads correctly to the MES for full traceability
Follow corrective actions through to closure and drive improvements in yield and test efficiency
Work with Production, Quality, Engineering, suppliers and global Lenovo teams, and give hands-on support when urgent issues come up

A bachelor’s degree or higher in Electronic, Electrical, Computer or Communication Engineering, Automation, Computer Science or a related field
2+ years in test engineering for mobile phone, consumer electronics or electronics manufacturing (preferred)

description_text:
Salla is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to take ownership of product quality across our platform. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that every release meets our quality standards, and you will be accountable for making informed go/no-go release decisions based on risk and test results.

You will be expected to define the most suitable QA approach for our product and teams, including the testing strategy, tools, standards, and workflows. This approach should be flexible, not rigid: you will adapt the depth, type, and process of testing to fit each situation, whether it's an urgent hotfix, a major feature launch, or a high-risk change.

This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to review requirements, define test strategies, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build reliable test automation using Playwright.

Beyond identifying and resolving defects, you will analyze their root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.

Responsibilities

Own quality end to end, building it in early through requirement reviews, design discussions, and test strategy, through to the final go/no-go call on releases
Define and continuously refine the QA approach, including testing standards, workflows, tools, and quality metrics. Adapt testing depth, process, and priorities to risk, timeline, and context rather than applying a one-size-fits-all process
Decide what needs testing, how deeply, and with which approach (functional, regression, API, UI, performance, security, usability). Decide what stays manual and what gets automated, and know when enough is enough
Perform thorough manual and exploratory testing on new features, finding what scripts miss: edge cases, unexpected user behavior, UX problems, and the UI details users notice (layout, states, responsiveness)
Build and maintain Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation that runs in CI, catches real issues instead of just adding to a test count, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback
Review code and pull requests properly: read them, question them, and push back when something isn't right
Triage defects and investigate them in depth using browser DevTools (network, console, performance, storage) to find root causes, not just symptoms, and help the team prioritize what matters most
Prevent recurring issues by identifying the pattern behind bugs, analyzing defect trends, and putting safeguards in place (tests, checks, process changes). Think ahead about how new features, scale, and changes will affect quality
Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up test creation, analysis, and debugging, and build AI-assisted workflows where they add value, while always validating the output
Communicate risks clearly to developers, product managers, and leadership, with a recommendation rather than just a report
Take initiative to spot gaps in our processes, tools, or product and drive improvements, while mentoring other QA engineers and raising the quality mindset across the team

Requirements

5+ years of QA experience with real ownership of releases and quality decisions
Strong experience in both manual and automated testing, and the judgment to balance the two
Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills, enough to write clean, maintainable Playwright automation and read application code with confidence
Hands-on experience with Playwright (or strong experience with a similar framework plus a willingness to go deep on Playwright)
Strong command of Git and GitHub: branching, pull requests, code reviews, and working within CI pipelines 
Deep understanding of testing types, techniques, and test design, and the judgment to choose the right one 
Flexibility to adjust your approach to different situations, avoiding rigid processes while keeping quality standards high
Experience testing web, mobile, and APIs
Comfort with browser DevTools for debugging and investigation
Practical experience using AI in your work, and the critical thinking to know when to trust it and when not to
A preventive mindset: you've fixed problems at their root, not just patched symptoms, and can give examples

Job Description

The QA Engineer is responsible for designing and executing manual and automated tests to verify software functionality, performance, reliability, and usability. The role ensures that digital solutions meet defined quality standards and user expectations by identifying defects and quality issues early in the development lifecycle and supporting their timely resolution.

Key Responsibilities

Execute manual and automated test cases to validate software functionality, performance, reliability, and usability.
Design, maintain, and update test cases and test scenarios based on requirements and acceptance criteria.
Identify, document, track, and verify software defects, providing clear information to support timely resolution.
Review requirements and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguities, and potential quality issues early in the development lifecycle.
Contribute to test planning by identifying appropriate test scenarios, test data, and estimating testing efforts.
Perform functional, regression, integration, and other applicable testing to ensure delivered features meet defined quality standards and acceptance criteria.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product teams, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and support the resolution of quality issues.
Maintain accurate test documentation and communicate testing progress, results, defects, and identified quality risks to relevant stakeholders.

Key Deliverables

Complete and accurate test cases and test scenarios aligned with requirements and acceptance criteria.
Documented test execution results with clear status, findings, and supporting evidence.
Complete and traceable defect reports, including reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and relevant logs.
Verified defect fixes with documented retest and regression results.
Completed functional, regression, integration, and other assigned testing within planned timelines.
Updated test coverage through additional scenarios, edge cases, and identified requirement gaps.
Accurate and up-to-date test documentation ensuring traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and results.
Clear test cycle status reports highlighting testing progress, defects, blockers, identified quality risks, and overall testing outcomes.

Job Requirements

Education, Certification & Years of experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field
Professional certifications or licenses required or preferred for this role: Master's degree, ISTQB test certificates
Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for this role: 2 to 4

Skills & Competencies

Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking: Ability to analyze software quality issues, identify root causes, and apply logical and structured approaches to problem resolution.
Attention to Detail: Ability to identify defects, inconsistencies, edge cases, and deviations from requirements and expected behavior.
Communication: Ability to communicate testing results, defects, quality risks, and technical information clearly and effectively to relevant stakeholders.
Quality Mindset: Commitment to maintaining high-quality standards and proactively identifying opportunities to improve software quality and user experience.
Adaptability & Learning Agility: Ability to learn and adapt to evolving technologies, testing tools, methodologies, and development practices.
Technical Aptitude: Ability to understand software systems, testing concepts, tools, and technologies relevant to quality assurance activities.
Planning & Prioritization: Ability to organize testing activities, manage priorities, and deliver assigned work within planned timelines.
Collaboration & Teamwork: Ability to work effectively with QA, development, product, business analysis, and other relevant teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Overview – Role

The Fire Systems Engineer - Mechanical will be a professional in the field of Fire Protection and Life Safety consulting with demonstrable experience in the design, construction and testing / commissioning phases of modern active fire protection systems.

Based in Khobar, this role will be responsible for working on wide range of projects based across Saudi Arabia.

This role offers the chance to work in a fast-paced environment and advance your career within a supportive and diverse team, to support the design and development of fire protection systems for a wide range of building types and industries. The ideal candidate is an early-career engineer with a strong interest in fire protection and a willingness to learn industry standards and software tools. A verifiable and demonstrated knowledge of design practices and approvals in KSA for Building Code and Life Safety requirements is a key requisite for this role. This also extends to the ability to engage and liaise with regulatory and approving authorities at various stages of design, construction and handover of projects.

Key Responsibilities

Design fire suppression systems such as firewater pump, firewater network, sprinkler system (wet, dry, pre-action), spray system, clean agent, kitchen hood system, etc.
Design detailed fire alarm system drawings, wiring diagrams, device layouts, riser diagrams, cause and effect matrix, and specifications
Perform voltage drop and battery calculations using specialized software (e.g., AlarmCAD, Honeywell tools)
Prepare design basis report for fire suppression system
Perform hydraulic calculations using software such as Elitefire and Pipenet
Perform theoretical calculation and can verify /interpret the flow calculation for clean agent system
Design/verify the kitchen hood fire extinguishing system
Develop schematic diagrams for fire water pumps, fire water network, sprinkler system, spray system, foam system, etc.
Prepare submittals, technical reports, and system documentation
Supervise designers to draft each fire protection system

Requirements And Qualifications

An accredited bachelor’s degree in mechanical, or related engineering field
7-12 years of experience in design and layout of mechanical or specialty engineering systems
In depth understanding of Building codes (National and International), Fire codes, NFPA 1, NFPA 13, NFPA 14, NFPA 15, NFPA 20, NFPA 22, NFPA 30, NFPA 70, NFPA 72, NFPA 101, NFPA 2001.
Good knowledge of national codes and standards such as the National Building Code, Fire Codes, and local standards like TAC, OISD, etc.
Proficiency with AutoCAD (Revit experience is a plus).
Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
Excellent report writing and interpersonal skills
Ability to present clear and technically sound engineering strategies, assess review results with excellent written and spoken communication skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, rise to professional challenges, and endeavour to be an integral part of the long-term growth of Jensen Hughes
Have the ability and desire to deliver the desired goals (completion of the project) on time and within budget
Ready to travel as required, to meet projects requirements

Why you should join Jensen Hughes

You will work with market-leading clients and have the backing of a leading international firm.
There is continued support from the leadership team with a flexible approach to carrying out day to day activities.
Career advancement with an established framework is in place – clearly defining expectations and outlining opportunities for advancement.

Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data. Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA. Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.

Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements

Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Description

SAIC is seeking Systems Engineers to support the U.S. Navy's Foreign Military Sales (FMS) C4I modernization program for the Royal Saudi Naval Forces (RSNF) on-site in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and Jubail, Saudi Arabia in direct support of the Naval Information Warfare Systems Command (NAVWAR) program office. The Systems Engineers will lead requirements analysis, technical site surveys, system verification, and analysis of alternatives (AoA) for the integration of C4I and Commercial Off The Shelf (COTS) capabilities into RSNF platforms and shore facilities. The selected candidate will interact routinely with U.S. Government and Saudi senior military and government officials and will produce technical documentation suitable for foreign disclosure release.

Perform end-to-end systems engineering for C4I capabilities (GCCS, NAVMACS, HF/UHF/VHF radios and antennas, Tactical Data Links Link-11/16/22, CENTRIXS, Network Communications, SATCOM, ADSI, VBSS) deployed to RSNF afloat and ashore.
Conduct technical site surveys at RSNF facilities in Riyadh, Jubail, and Jeddah; capture as-built configurations and translate operational needs into engineering requirements.
Plan and execute System Operation Verification Tests (SOVTs); develop test procedures, witness installations, document discrepancies, and drive resolution.
Research and conduct Analysis of Alternatives (AoA) for COTS products (radars, GPS, AIS, Radio Direction Finding, EO cameras, GMDSS, APS, Emergency Radio, FOTN, CCTV, Video Display, VTC) and provide trade studies with recommendations.
Support Systems Engineering and Technical Reviews (SETR) including SRR, PDR, CDR, and TRR events; prepare and present engineering artifacts.
Author and sanitize technical documentation for foreign disclosure review; coordinate disclosure determinations with the U.S. Government Foreign Disclosure Office.
Interface with U.S. Government (NAVWAR program managers, GS-15 civilians, O-6 field grade officers) and senior RSNF military and government officials.
Contribute engineering inputs to the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and brief schedule status to program leadership in MS Project and MS PowerPoint.
Identify, document, and mitigate technical risks; escalate cost, schedule, or performance impacts to the Program Manager.
Comply with all OCONUS work, security, and country-clearance requirements; maintain valid U.S. passport and Kingdom of Saudi Arabia work documentation.

Qualifications

Required Education

Bachelor's degree in an Engineering field from an accredited college or university and five (5 years’ experience.

Required Clearance

Must possess an active Secret security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.

Required Skills

Five or more (5+) years of experience supporting C4I systems (e.g., GCCS, NAVMACS, Tactical Data Links, Radios/Antennas, SATCOM, ADSI, or similar systems).
Three or more (3+) years of experience with COTS equipment (e.g., radars, GPS, EO cameras, GMDSS, APS, FOTN, CCTV, or VTC systems).
Experience working OCONUS in security cooperation efforts, engaging with U.S. Government or foreign senior military/government officials.
Expertise with foreign disclosure, technical documentation sanitization, site surveys, SOVTs, or AoAs of COTS products.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills related to C4I systems and network communications.

Desired Skills Or Required Certifications

Three or more (3+) years of experience with NAVWAR prime mission products and supporting Systems Engineering and Technical Reviews (SETR).
Completion of DISAM Security Cooperation Management (SCM) courses (e.g., SCM-CONUS) and/or DISAM International Affairs Certification Level 1 or above.
Experience working in austere locations (e.g., Middle Eastern nations) supporting security cooperation efforts or foreign customers.
Proficiency in developing and presenting Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) using tools like MS Project and MS PowerPoint (or similar).
Master's degree in an Engineering field from an accredited institution.
